windows_failure.basis: Complete operator-supplied Windows console, final JSON, inline fixed failure evidence and actual CMD prompt return; saved JSON/sidecar were not independently uploaded.
windows_failure.interpretation: The generic runtime reason also covers failures before or after credential acceptance. The supplied evidence does not name the worker auth code or original underlying exception. Separate controlled contention reproduces the same generic stop but does not establish the exact original Windows cause.
